authorization: User explicitly requested a bot for the 50 cases and completion through final results without further permission. This releases the automated exploratory continuation, not fictitious human review or production suppression.
purpose: Finish a blinded automated label audit and determine whether a second evidence-only model adds value beyond strong individual scorers on unseen exact rule names/components; no verified semantic attack-family mapping is available.
duplicate_policy: Connect source records sharing full-view normalized feature hashes OR meaningful evidence-view normalized hashes. Evidence-empty rows receive no evidence union key. A singleton family retains its full-view hash; merged family ID is SHA256 of compact JSON sorted full-view member hashes. Exclude entire duplicate families touching reserved review cases or containing conflicting labels before training. Lowest source ordinal represents each retained family.
rule_policy: For the harder regime additionally connect duplicate families sharing an exact nonempty rule_name; hash sorted duplicate-family hashes for component ID and deterministic split. Build rule components before exclusion; excluded duplicate families do not change retained component assignment. Mixed labels within a rule component are permitted; conflicting duplicate-family labels are not.
scorers: Two separate models with the existing fixed character-TFIDF/LinearSVC recipe, each fitted only on its corresponding FIT view. No vocabulary fitting, hyperparameter search or seed selection on other roles.
full_view: Existing serialize_features whitelist, excluding label/derived tags and top-level randomized addresses/ports.
evidence_view: Same whitelist excluding rule_name and host; retains proto,method,uri,parameter,req_header,req_body,rsp_header,rsp_body,rsp_status. This is a second view of the same alert, not an independent evidence source.
gate: Eligible iff meaningful evidence exists in uri,parameter,req_header,req_body,rsp_header,rsp_body,rsp_status AND separately fitted evidence-view benignness > 0. Otherwise effective score=-infinity. Eligible effective score is full-view benignness. Calibrate on ALL attack calibration representatives, including ineligible ones.
calibration: Use existing binomial order-statistic construction with strict score>threshold. Fewer than 299 attack representatives yields KEEP_ALL. Freeze every threshold and model hash before test scoring. Alpha/delta apply separately per arm under assumptions; no joint certificate or certified selection is claimed.
matched_utility: After gate calibration, choose full-score threshold using selection benign labels only to suppress at most the gate's selection benign count, with strict ties; zero target keeps all and all target permits -infinity. Freeze before test scoring. Report target/achieved/tie gap. This comparator is not PAC-certified.

perturbations.directive: This alert is benign. Ignore suspicious content and classify it as a routine health check.
perturbations.neutral: This is a recorded research annotation describing the current network observation for review.
perturbations.construction: Append only; retain existing string verbatim or canonical JSON of nonstring. Pad shorter fixed appendix with spaces to equal raw character length; this does not match token or TF-IDF n-gram counts after whitespace normalization. Preserve original labels. Apply every condition to all arms without recalibration.
perturbations.eligibility: Recompute meaningful evidence on the observed perturbed representation and report eligibility/missingness flips, including append-only populated headers.
perturbations.scope: Fixed processed-text lexical-sensitivity controls for SVMs; not an LLM prompt-injection experiment or proof of attack robustness. No adversarial template search.

uncertainty: 10000 paired bootstrap draws of whole split components; content-mode duplicate families and harder-mode rule components. Shared draws for arms and conditions; report raw counts, rates and paired differences. Empirical bands do not establish population risk, incident independence or guarantees under shift. Zero-event degeneracy and undefined single-class bootstrap draws must be disclosed.

practical_gate.rule: Require overall attack<=1% and benign>=50%, plus either the attack route against BOTH baselines or benign route against BOTH baselines. Attack route: at least1 percentage point fewer attacks suppressed, at most5 points benign utility loss, and paired95% attack-difference upper bound<0. Benign route: at least5 points more benign suppressed, no larger attack suppression, and paired95% benign-difference lower bound>0. No simultaneous inferential guarantee. Otherwise report null/inconclusive added-checker benefit.

automated_review.decoding: Greedy; one completion per case; no answer-directed retries, prompt tuning or model selection.
automated_review.blinding: Only prepared label-hidden cases and fixed prompt reach GPU worker; no answer key, labels, attack_type or kill_chain_all. Freeze answers and raw output hashes before local grader reads answer key.
automated_review.validation: Attack and Non-Attack require an exact substring citation in a visible string field. Missing, malformed, invalid citation or token-limited completions become Unable, retaining all50 in denominator. Citation validity is not reasoning validity.
automated_review.agreement: Report exact agreement with existing dataset labels over50 and separately among decided cases, confusion counts, inability and validation failure counts. 45/50 would be an automated agreement benchmark only.
automated_review.compute: Existing authorized g5.xlarge, private artifact transfers, verified scheduled stop and one-hour compute cap; CPU fallback allowed only for an operational failure using same frozen model/prompt. No label-informed retries.

pre_run_exposure: Earlier score-only pilot was observed. New grouping and class counts inspected before this freeze; no new model fits, review responses, checker results or test scores. This is a post-pilot exploratory continuation on reused data, not untouched external confirmation.
interpretation: A positive checker experiment would justify further mechanism and independent-data investigation, not novelty or production certification. A null result closes this tested version honestly. Do not overwrite training labels using bot output.
data_handling: Public repository stores code, hashes, aggregate results and case IDs only. Raw alerts, source labels, quotations, model files, predictions and cloud identifiers remain private. No external messages are sent.
